title: Sex, Spies and Silicon Valley: OpenAI Warns Staff About "Honey Pots"
hook_text: OpenAI just warned staff about honey pots.
script:
OpenAI just warned employees in Silicon Valley about foreign honey pots.
Foreign spies are targeting artificial intelligence researchers with fake romantic setups.
Attackers use these romantic traps to steal valuable company secrets and algorithms.
The security memo highlights how state actors now chase critical artificial intelligence breakthroughs.
Tech laboratories face escalating espionage threats as models become more powerful.
Would you spot a honey pot trap at work?
